notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: This record couldn't be found. It may not exist, or it may be further back than this console currently searches.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.body: You don't have permission to view this page.

unavailable.title: Monitoring unavailable
unavailable.body: The console could not load this data. Do not read this panel as healthy or empty until it loads.

unauthenticated.title: Session expired
unauthenticated.body: Sign in again to load this data.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: You don't have permission to view this data.

aiDefaultNotice.title: AI features are now on for this workspace
aiDefaultNotice.body: AI prompts may be processed outside the UAE after sensitive data is removed. You can turn them off in Settings.

aiOptInNotice.title: Turn on AI features?
aiOptInNotice.body: AI features are off for this workspace. If you turn them on, AI prompts may be processed outside the UAE after sensitive data is removed.

expiring.title: Your Manar licence expires soon
expiring.body: It expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, on {date}. Renew it before then.

over_limit.title: This deployment uses more than its licence covers
over_limit.body: It has more agents or tenants than the licence allows. Extend the licence to cover them.

not_yet_valid.title: The installed Manar licence is not active yet
not_yet_valid.body: Its start date is still to come. Check that the right licence file is installed.

invalid.title: The Manar licence could not be verified
invalid.body: The installed licence file is damaged or was not issued for Manar. Ask for a new licence file.

unverifiable.title: This version of Manar cannot check the installed licence
unverifiable.body: The licence was signed with a key this version does not know. Ask for a matching licence or an update.

missing.title: No Manar licence is installed
missing.body: This deployment has no licence file. Install one.
